records.name: Wyoming
records.summary: Wyoming signed public-facility bans in March 2025. A July 2026 per-state legal-risk assessment lists it among 'the worst states' for legislation targeting transgender adults.

records.name: West Virginia
records.summary: March 2025 facility ban with unusually wide reach: K-12, higher education, corrections and domestic-violence shelters. In the worst-law group per the July 2026 legal-risk assessment. Below the national score 0.36.

records.name: Arkansas
records.summary:
Arkansas confines trans students to birth-sex school facilities under a March 2023 law (HB 1156) that remains in force and was extended in 2025; its school focus means visitor exposure is narrower than in states with adult-reaching bans.

Its ban on gender-affirming care for minors remains in litigation (en-banc review of an injunction reversal pending), and the July 2026 per-state legal-risk grading lists Arkansas among the worst states.
